alt: 少年平時只顧玩遊戲，書本與教學材料一直沒碰，遇到簡單的組裝工作時，便完全不知怎麼做。
scene_prompt: 不學無術 means lacking knowledge and practical ability because one has not learned. Modern teenage study/work corner. Several neglected CLOSED instruction books and unused learning materials sit pushed aside, while an older teen distractedly holds a plain unbranded handheld game device. On the desk directly in front of him a very simple wooden assembly puzzle is wrongly put together and cannot stand, despite a clear picture-only instruction sheet lying ignored nearby. He now looks baffled and shrugs when asked to perform the basic task. Contrast ignored opportunity to learn with absence of skill, not disability, poverty or inability to access education. No words, numerals, brand interfaces, insults or shaming adult.
